title: Starter quota staggered vesting + enterprise SQ gating for PLG conversion
creator: Lena Park
description:
Background: Current free-tier gives a one-time token grant that both converts poorly on mid-funnel enterprise prospects and is susceptible to short-term churn. Goal: test whether a staggered (vesting) starter quota combined with a security-questionnaire (SQ) gating flow for enterprise leads to higher paid conversion, higher retention at 30/90 days, and fewer support-led contract motions.

Hypothesis: A starter quota that unlocks in three pulses (40% at signup, 35% after 7 days of active use, 25% after 21 days) reduces token exhaustion anxiety and increases engagement; pairing a proactive SQ prompt for accounts that cross a usage threshold will shorten legal/security review cycles and increase conversion velocity for enterprise customers.

Experiment design: 3x2 factorial test. Arms: A1 (Control): current one-shot starter quota (10k tokens, 30-day expiry). A2: Staggered vesting - 10k total but released in pulses with 30-day final expiry. A3: Staggered + extended expiry variant - total 15k with same pulses but 60-day final expiry. For each pricing arm we run two SQ treatments: SQ-Soft (in-app non-blocking invite to complete short security questionnaire with incentives: +5k top-up when completed) and SQ-Hard (blocking modal after crossing 8k usage that asks teams to start SQ to unlock extended quota/enterprise contract path).

Primary metrics (tracked at account level):
- Paid conversion rate within 30 days (conversion_paid_30d)
- Time-to-first-paid (days)
- Net new MRR among converted accounts at 90 days
- 30-day retention by active user cohort (DAU/MAU fallback)
- Support tickets for quota exhaustion per 1k trial accounts

Secondary metrics / safety signals:
- Abuse signals: multiple accounts from same billing identity, disposable email indexes
- Refund / chargeback rate within 60 days
- SQ drop-off and completion rate

Sample sizing / power: Targeting to detect a 1.5% absolute lift in 30-day paid conversion (baseline 3.5%) with 80% power -> ~6,200 accounts per arm. Rollout will be capped to 8,000 accounts/arm or 6 weeks, whichever comes first.

Instrumentation / analytic events (required):
- trial.started
- starter_quota.pulse_unlocked
- starter_quota.exhausted
- sq.prompt_shown
- sq.completed
- upgrade_prompt_shown
- account.converted_to_paid
- support.ticket_created_quota

Rollout plan:
- Week 0: Feature flag behind experiment key pm/110123. Engineering to build vesting API and SQ modal. QA on staging with synthetic accounts.
- Week 1–2: Small beta with internal + partners (n=200). Verify telemetry.
- Week 3–8: Launch full experiment to public signups routed by RNG bucketing (stratified by geolocation and signup source).
- Safety rollback: If we observe >2x baseline abuse rate or >5% increase in support tickets attributable to quota flows within first 72 hours, rollback vesting to control.

Enterprise contract / SQ integration notes:
- SQ steps must feed into CRM (HubSpot/ADP integration) and create a ticket in Legal ops. We should auto-create an "SQ intake" task when sq.completed = true.
- For SQ-Hard accounts that ask for immediate contract, route to Sales queue with pre-populated security answers and telemetry package (token usage, API endpoint patterns, model families used).
- Propose an enterprise addendum clause to allow temporary extended trial/quota for customers actively completing SQ for security committees. Legal to review draft clause (see links in comments).

Success criteria (go / no-go):
- Primary: statistically significant lift in paid conversion within 30 days in at least one staggered arm vs control at p<0.05 AND no material negative signal on abuse or support (>10% relative increase).
- Secondary: SQ-Soft completion rate >20% and SQ-Hard completion rate >40% among accounts that cross usage threshold. Reduced median time for enterprise contract closure by >=10 days for accounts that complete SQ.

Operational concerns:
- Risk of customer confusion: copy and onboarding flow must communicate vesting schedule clearly (email + in-app banner). Design/UX to provide a progress bar for remaining pulses.
- Accounting: confirm recognition rules with finance for promotional token top-ups (extended quotas shouldn't be recognized as revenue but must be tracked).
- Edge cases: Marketplace / reseller signups should be excluded from the experiment (marked via signup_source).

Artifacts & links: PRD in Confluence (contrib link), experiment dashboard skeleton in Looker, feature flags in LaunchDarkly (pm-110123-v1).

Acceptance criteria: All instrumentation events captured in prod, successful small beta with no safety triggers, legal draft for enterprise addendum uploaded, and analytics team confirms cohort queries return expected dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Vesting API implemented and feature-flagged. 2) All experiment events emitted and validated in staging. 3) Beta run with <=200 test accounts with no safety triggers. 4) Legal draft addendum uploaded and SQ flow defined. 5) Analytics SQLs for primary metrics reviewed and approved.
